summary: Real Brokerage Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing an Arrangement Agreement to acquire REMAX Holdings. Shareholders of REMAX can elect $13.80 cash or 5.150 shares of new entity Real REMAX Group per share, with aggregate cash capped between $60M and $80M. Real shareholders receive one share of Real REMAX Group per consolidated Real share (10:1 reverse split). Post-close, Real shareholders own ~59% and REMAX holders ~41% at midpoint. The transaction is structured as a plan of arrangement under British Columbia law with sequential mergers. Watch for regulatory approvals, proration mechanics, and shareholder vote; risk-arb focuses on cash/stock election mix.
